## About
Multidisciplinary artist, creative entrepreneur & educator.
Current focus: Building a creative studio, mentoring the next generation, and exploring art as a practice of attention.
I'm a tattoo artist, creative entrepreneur and educator working where image, identity and story meet. For over a decade I've built studios, led teams and shaped brands — always guided by the belief that craft is a form of care.

## Experience
- Owner & Creative Director @ Romans Tattoo (2018–present) — Wolsztyn, Poland
  I founded and lead Romans Tattoo — a studio built around craft, trust and care. Over the years I've grown it into an eight-person team, launched three studios across cities, and shaped every layer of the brand, from visual identity to the way a client feels in the chair.
- Tattoo Artist & Content Creator @ Independent Practice (2014–present) — Poland
  Before the studio, I worked freelance — tattooing, building brands for small businesses and producing photo and video content. It was a formative season of conventions, late-night drawing and learning to treat every client like a collaboration.

## Projects
- Painting workshops for children — https://mikolajmrozek.base44.app/projects/warsztaty-malerskie-dzieci
  I teach children painting, conveying the basics of techniques, impressions, and color theory. I build the lesson plan dynamically, not always indoors and not always with a single medium.
- Cancer Fighters — Charity Initiative — https://mikolajmrozek.base44.app/projects/cancer-fighters-charity
  The Cancer Fighters Charity Picnic in Wolsztyn brought together artists, clients, and the local community for a single purpose: supporting children fighting cancer. We turned a day of tattooing into a powerful fundraising initiative.
- Mikołaj Mrozek — TATTOO Portfolio — https://mikolajmrozek.base44.app/projects/portfolio-tattoo-mikolaj-mrozek
  For me, tattooing is a combination of art, technique, and an individual human story. Since 2014, I have been developing my own approach to neotraditional tattooing, combining inspiration from Art Nouveau, strong contrast, and composition with the vision of the person for whom the tattoo will become a part of their body.
- Plein-air painting (August impressions) — https://mikolajmrozek.base44.app/projects/plener-malerski-sierpien-wrazen
